transcript.answer: Otto was planned for Cloud Run in `europe-north1` (issue #27) so that it would sit in the same region as the Vertex model, which would answer OLT's NIS-2 data-residency condition. That was never built. Otto was deployed instead to the shared GKE cluster `n8n-cluster` in `europe-west1`, and the specs record this divergence. The region choice also lost its premise. Measurements on 2026-10-16 showed `europe-north1` serves only the Gemini 2.5 models, which retire on 2026-10-20. All current Gemini models, including the 3.x family and `gemini-4-argon`, are served from the `eu` multi-region instead. So after 2026-10-20 no Gemini model on Vertex runs in `europe-north1`. The model now runs on Vertex AI's `eu` multi-region. PR #416 closed #27 as superseded and recorded the actual deployment in ADR-003. The planned `ADR-001-hosting-platform.md` was never written, and ADR-001 is now the TMS authentication decision (#15). I found no source stating why the team chose GKE over Cloud Run beyond this. The sources say Cloud Run was not built and the region premise is gone.

judgements.reason: The answer states that europe-north1 served only Gemini 2.5, which retired on 2026-10-20, and that newer models are on the eu multi-region, and it says Otto runs on GKE n8n-cluster in europe-west1; it omits only the Autopilot qualifier, which is not essential.
